newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DOLLAR ON HOLD IN SINGAPORE, AWAITS BUBA REPO.
newsitem.headline: DOLLAR ON HOLD IN SINGAPORE, AWAITS BUBA REPO.

text.p: The U.S. dollar shuffled about in relatively subdued ranges on Tuesday as players awaited the Bundesbank's money market operation for an indication of Germany's interest rate outlook, Singapore dealers said.
"The whole market is focused on whether the Buba is going to do a variable rate repo or a fixed rate repo," a European bank dealer said.
The Bundesbank is expected to make an announcement sometime after 0700 GMT on whether it will adopt fixed or variable rates in its weekly money market operation.
If the German central bank adopted variable rates, it would signal the possibility of an impending rate hike and that would weigh on dollar/mark and dollar/yen, the dealer said.
He said the dollar looked supported around 1.8580 marks but its gains were likely to be capped near 1.8670 marks for the time being.

A senior trader at a European bank in Tokyo said guiding money rates higher would be inconsistent with policies the Buba has taken. A higher German rate and the reversal of a weak mark trend would wreck the single European currency, he said.
Dealers said the dollar looked well bid at 115.70 yen but would face selling pressure above 116.30 yen.
